  describe('server-supplied retry delay', () => {
    afterEach(() => {
      vi.restoreAllMocks()
    })

    const spyDelays = (): number[] => {
      const delays: number[] = []
      vi.spyOn(global, 'setTimeout').mockImplementation(((
        cb: () => void,
        ms?: number
      ) => {
        delays.push(ms ?? 0)
        cb()
        return 0 as unknown as NodeJS.Timeout
      }) as typeof setTimeout)
      return delays
    }

    it('uses error.retryAfterMs verbatim instead of exponential backoff', async () => {
      const delays = spyDelays()
      class ThrottledError extends Error {
        retryAfterMs = 250
      }
      let calls = 0
      const result = await retry(
        async () => {
          calls++
          if (calls < 3) throw new ThrottledError('slow down')
          return 'ok'
        },
        { maxAttempts: 5, baseDelayMs: 100, shouldRetry: () => true }
      )
      expect(result).toBe('ok')
      expect(delays).toEqual([250, 250])
    })

    it('falls back to exponential backoff when retryAfterMs is missing or invalid', async () => {
      const delays = spyDelays()
      class BadHeader extends Error {
        retryAfterMs: unknown
        constructor(value: unknown) {
          super('bad')
          this.retryAfterMs = value
        }
      }
      const invalids: unknown[] = [undefined, 'soon', -10, NaN, Infinity]
      let i = 0
      let calls = 0
      await retry(
        async () => {
          calls++
          if (calls <= invalids.length) throw new BadHeader(invalids[i++])
          return 'ok'
        },
        {
          maxAttempts: invalids.length + 1,
          baseDelayMs: 100,
          shouldRetry: () => true,
        }
      )
      expect(delays).toHaveLength(invalids.length)
      for (const d of delays) {
        expect(d).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(100)
        expect(d).not.toBe(250)
      }
    })

    it('decides per attempt based on the current error', async () => {
      const delays = spyDelays()
      class ThrottledError extends Error {
        retryAfterMs = 250
      }
      let calls = 0
      await retry(
        async () => {
          calls++
          if (calls === 1) throw new ThrottledError('slow')
          if (calls === 2) throw new Error('plain')
          if (calls === 3) throw new ThrottledError('slow again')
          return 'ok'
        },
        { maxAttempts: 5, baseDelayMs: 100, shouldRetry: () => true }
      )
      expect(delays).toHaveLength(3)
      expect(delays[0]).toBe(250)
      expect(delays[1]).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(200)
      expect(delays[1]).not.toBe(250)
      expect(delays[2]).toBe(250)
    })
  })
